label: DS-21 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses the three-gene DefensePredictor-discovered system 21 locus cataloged as working transcriptional unit TOXO and whose plasmid expression in E. coli MG1655 reduced bacteriophage plaquing.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from the TOXO source working identifier, the individual DS-21 genes and proteins, the DS-21A/DS-21B/DS-21C HMM profile rows, cloned-transcriptional-unit plaquing assays, the PDDEXK HHpred-domain annotation, the absent DS-21 rule-level DefenseFinder model, unresolved DS-21 component activity and phage readouts, and other DefensePredictor-discovered or phage-defense systems.
